strings.jp:
ちょっとそこのあんた、
道を空けて頂戴
strings.en:
Hey, you there.
Clear the way, would you?

strings.jp:
誰が人間どもの言うことなどに
従うものか!
strings.en:
As if I'd obey the
words of a human!

strings.jp:
エ、エメローネ様…
無力な私をお許しください……
strings.en:
E-Emelone-sama... Forgive
me for being so powerless...

strings.jp:
馬鹿ね、どいていれば
死なずに済むものを…
strings.en:
Silly girl. If you'd moved,
you wouldn't have died...

strings.jp:
最初からどいていれば
こんな目には遣わないのよ?
strings.en:
If you'd just moved, you
wouldn't be like this, hm?

strings.jp:
くっ…人間風情が……
よくも……
strings.en:
Tch... Mere humans...
How dare you...

strings.jp: 侵略者め、思い知ったか!?
strings.en:
Invader, have you learned
your lesson!?
